verdict.rationale: Cloudflare documents a first-party Registrar API covering searching, checking, registering, and managing domains, and publishes an OpenAPI spec. That covers the core registration lifecycle programmatically. However, the evidence never shows full parity with the dashboard, and many UI-documented actions have no confirmed API equivalent. Missing for 10: evidence of API coverage for transfers, WHOIS contact edits, DNSSEC activation, lock/unlock and auto-renew toggling, plus an explicit parity statement or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Registrar API for searching, checking, registering, and managing domains through Cloudflare Registrar.
